5\. Lalonde figures

```{r}
library(MatchIt)
library(leaps)
data(lalonde)

y <- lalonde$re78
X_vars <- c("age","educ", "hisp","married","nodegr","re74","re75","treat")

sub_fit <- regsubsets(re78 ~ age + educ + married +
                              nodegree + re74 + re75 + treat,
                      data    = lalonde,
                      nvmax   = 9,
                      method  = "exhaustive")

sub_sum <- summary(sub_fit)
n       <- nrow(lalonde)
p_vec   <- 1:9          # number of predictors in model of size k


rss_vec <- sub_sum$rss
k_vec   <- p_vec + 1          # +1 for intercept

aic_vec <- n * log(rss_vec / n) + 2 * k_vec

bic_vec <- n * log(rss_vec / n) + k_vec * log(n)

gcv_vec <- (rss_vec / n) / (1 - k_vec / n)^2



press_vec <- numeric(9)
for (k in 1:7) {
  vars_k   <- names(which(sub_sum$which[k, -1]))   # drop intercept column
  formula_k <- as.formula(paste("re78 ~", paste(vars_k, collapse = " + ")))
  fit_k    <- lm(formula_k, data = lalonde)
  h_ii     <- hatvalues(fit_k)
  e_i      <- residuals(fit_k)
  press_vec[k] <- sum((e_i / (1 - h_ii))^2)
}

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

plot(p_vec, aic_vec,    pch = 19,
     xlab = "# predictors", ylab = "AIC",   main = "AIC")

plot(p_vec, bic_vec,    pch = 19,
     xlab = "# predictors", ylab = "BIC",   main = "BIC")

plot(p_vec, press_vec,  pch = 19, 
     xlab = "# predictors", ylab = "PRESS", main = "PRESS")

plot(p_vec, gcv_vec,    pch = 19, 
     xlab = "# predictors", ylab = "GCV",   main = "GCV")

```

6.  Noise , Boston housing data

```{r}
library(MASS)       # Boston data
library(glmnet)     # ridge and lasso

set.seed(42)
data(Boston)


y    <- Boston$medv
X_orig <- model.matrix(medv ~ ., data = Boston)[, -1]   # 13 original predictors
n    <- nrow(X_orig)   # 506

# Helper: fit OLS / ridge / lasso and return test MSE
compare_models <- function(X_full, y, label) {
  # 80/20 train-test split
  set.seed(42)
  train_idx <- sample(n, floor(0.8 * n))
  test_idx  <- setdiff(1:n, train_idx)

  X_tr <- X_full[train_idx, ];  y_tr <- y[train_idx]
  X_te <- X_full[test_idx,  ];  y_te <- y[test_idx]

  #  OLS
  ols_df   <- data.frame(y = y_tr, X_tr)
  ols_fit  <- lm(y ~ ., data = ols_df)
  ols_pred <- predict(ols_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_te))
  ols_mse  <- mean((y_te - ols_pred)^2)

  #  Ridge 
  cv_ridge  <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, y_tr, alpha = 0, nfolds = 10)
  ridge_pred <- predict(cv_ridge, s = "lambda.min", newx = X_te)
  ridge_mse  <- mean((y_te - ridge_pred)^2)

  #  Lasso 
  cv_lasso  <- cv.glmnet(X_tr, y_tr, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
  lasso_pred <- predict(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min", newx = X_te)
  lasso_mse  <- mean((y_te - lasso_pred)^2)

  # Number of non-zero lasso coefficients
  lasso_nz  <- sum(coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min") != 0) - 1  # excl. intercept

  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s ===\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("  OLS   test MSE: %.3f\n", ols_mse))
  cat(sprintf("  Ridge test MSE: %.3f  (lambda=%.4f)\n",
              ridge_mse, cv_ridge$lambda.min))
  cat(sprintf("  Lasso test MSE: %.3f  (lambda=%.4f, non-zero coefs: %d)\n",
              lasso_mse, cv_lasso$lambda.min, lasso_nz))

  invisible(list(ols=ols_mse, ridge=ridge_mse, lasso=lasso_mse))
}

res0 <- compare_models(X_orig, y, "Original (p=13)")

noise1 <- matrix(rnorm(n * n), nrow = n)
X1     <- cbind(X_orig, noise1)          
res1   <- compare_models(X1, y, "p = n noise columns added (p=519)")

noise2 <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2 * n), nrow = n)
X2     <- cbind(X_orig, noise2)          # p = 13 + 1012 = 1025

res2_ridge_lasso <- compare_models(X2[, ], y,
                                   "p = 2n noise columns added (p=1025)")

scenarios <- c("Original\n(p=13)", "p = n\n(p=519)", "p = 2n\n(p=1025)")
ols_mse   <- c(res0$ols,   res1$ols,   NA)    # OLS undefined at p>n_train
ridge_mse <- c(res0$ridge, res1$ridge, res2_ridge_lasso$ridge)
lasso_mse <- c(res0$lasso, res1$lasso, res2_ridge_lasso$lasso)

barplot(rbind(ols_mse, ridge_mse, lasso_mse),
        beside  = TRUE,
        names.arg = scenarios,
        col     = c("steelblue","darkorange","darkgreen"),
        legend.text = c("OLS","Ridge","Lasso"),
        args.legend = list(x = "topleft"),
        ylab    = "Test MSE",
        main    = "Boston Housing: OLS vs Ridge vs Lasso\nas noise columns increase",
        ylim    = c(0, max(c(ols_mse, ridge_mse, lasso_mse), na.rm=TRUE) * 1.2))
```
